patch.summary: Shopify migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Shopify by inventorying legacy ecommerce fields, mapping them to Shopify objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Stripe, PayPal, Facebook before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price
Success signal: online storefront works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Shopify migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power online storefront, product catalog, checkout payments and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Shopify; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Stripe; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Merchants wanting a hosted store without managing infrastructure outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price
If Shopify mapping is poor, compare destination fit with BigCommerce before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Stripe in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Third-party payment gateways incur additional transaction fees on lower tiers

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Plus and advanced B2B features require higher plans or add-ons

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for online storefront
Mitigate: Subscription plus apps/themes and payment spreads raise TCO versus headline plan price

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
